title: Fix Host-Client Desynchronization of Lighthouse Wheel and Prism Positions in PlayScene2
description: Fix peer desynchronization where the Host sees the corrected ground positions for the steering wheel and socket pedestal under the lighthouse, but the remote Client (peer player) still sees them at the old floating positions. Implement runtime authoritative transform enforcement in MarshBeaconTrigger (Awake and OnNetworkSpawn) to guarantee identical coordinates across both peers regardless of local scene cache, and commit PlayScene2.unity with all materials to Git.
acceptance_criteria: EnforceAuthoritativeTransforms() in MarshBeaconTrigger executes in Awake() and OnNetworkSpawn() on all peers, snapping pedestals, itemSockets, and turnWheels to the ground stone island.
Remote client sees the wheel, socket, and inserted prism at the exact same grounded position as the host (y ~ 1.6m - 1.7m).
PlayScene2.unity scene file and LVL2_LighthouseBeam.mat material are tracked, committed, and ready to be pushed to remote.
test_command: Unity Editor MenuItem: 'Hold My Hand/Level 2/Wire Beacons Watermill and Victory'
risks: Ensure client also commits and pulls the PlayScene2.unity scene binary so mesh references and lightmaps are identical.
